title: Choose the visual world
question: Same colors and rounded shapes as Baby today. Only the components move. Comida stays the big tap. Popó, sueño, and medicina stay small. The clock keeps ±10 minutes and ±1 hour. Avisos have to stop you at a glance, and only the last two logs of each kind stay visible.

options.label: Log first
options.lineage: Today’s dark rounded cards, redrawn so the handoff is the header
options.thesis: The last two of each kind sit under a lamp aviso. The big rounded Comida pad, clock included, sits below.
options.viewport: A lamp aviso band, then two compact rows each for Comida, Popó, Sueño, and Medicina, then one large rounded Comida pad carrying 03:40 and the pads −1 h, +1 h, −10, +10, then three small rounded keys.
options.risk: The log leads, so the big tap sits lower and a tired thumb has to travel.

raised.raise: Reversed plate: the aviso is the only region that inverts into lamp gold.
Apparatus rank: the aviso gets Hecho and a full band. A log row gets only a time and a name.
One owner: the Comida pad is the only large object. The log stays a compact header.
Accent budget: lamp gold is only the aviso, the clock, and Comida. The small keys stay plain.
Clock as specimen: 03:40 is the largest type. The pads step it. Nothing drags.

options.label: Time on Comida
options.lineage: Today’s rounded pad, with the clock living on the button
options.thesis: One big rounded Comida pad holds the clock and the nudge keys. Tap it to log.
options.viewport: A lamp aviso, then one huge rounded pad: 03:40, the four nudge keys, and COMIDA. Three small keys under it. The two-line log sits below the pad.
options.risk: This is the most direct redraw of the screen you already have, and it can feel like a small tweak.

options.label: Stays lit
options.lineage: A gate board, translated into today’s rounded cards and lamp gold
options.thesis: The aviso row holds lamp gold until someone marks Hecho. It does not fade into the list.
options.viewport: A solid lamp row for the aviso, a ranked stack of two rounded rows per kind, and a large rounded Comida segment with the clock and nudge keys.
options.case: Holds the rule that a change stays lit until you notice. The boarding-pass shape is dropped so the screen stays today’s cards.
options.risk: The lit row can shout over the tap if the gold spreads.

options.label: Timetable rack
options.lineage: A pocket timetable on raked glass slides
options.thesis: One type size, rank by weight, slides on a rake.
options.case: One type size forbids a huge Comida pad, and the rake is not today’s shape.
options.kept: Reversed plate: the aviso is the only inverted region.
options.risk: Comida shrinks to the size of the log.

options.label: Lexicon
options.thesis: Guide words name the span. Rank is how much apparatus a row gets.
options.viewport: A book spread with a shoulder index.
options.case: A book page is not the night tap, and cream stock breaks today’s colors.
options.kept: Apparatus rank: the aviso gets the control. A log row gets time and name.
options.risk: It reads as a reference book.

options.label: Catalog sleeve
options.lineage: A factory-records sleeve of coded color and a white plot
options.thesis: Names become color codes. One plot owns the black field.
options.viewport: A black field, a pulse of lines, no words.
options.case: Hidden labels fail a 3am tap, and the black field drops the lamp gold.
options.kept: One owner: only Comida is large.

options.label: Product page
options.thesis: One accent, ghost buttons, a claim then a proof.
options.viewport: A light marketing page with a small accent button.
options.case: A marketing page is not the logger, and a light ground breaks today’s night screen.
options.kept: Accent budget: gold only on the aviso, the clock, and Comida.
options.risk: The tap becomes a ghost button.

options.label: Type specimen
options.thesis: One giant character, dragged along an axis.
options.viewport: A giant letter and a weight slider.
options.case: A drag slider is not the ±10 and ±1 hour taps, and there is no log.
options.kept: Clock as specimen: 03:40 is the largest type, stepped by pads.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Four equal soft tiles, a small clock, and a gentle list. What baby logs usually ship.
canonCard.viewport: A header, four emoji tiles in a square, a quiet aviso banner, and a timeline under them.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other baby log, and Comida is the same size as Popó.
